overlay_attack.description: Use of overlay windows or alert dialogs to present fake banking or credential capture screens.

sms_interception.description: Read, send, or intercept SMS messages to capture one-time passwords or banking transaction confirmations.

credential_harvesting.description: Collect user credentials or authentication tokens via fake login screens, forms, or injected overlays.

accessibility_abuse.description: Use accessibility services to monitor input, intercept UI interactions, or manipulate other apps.

dynamic_loading.description: Load code from external sources or dynamically generated payloads at runtime.

c2_communication.description: Communicate with remote infrastructure over HTTP/S, sockets, or custom protocols.

obfuscation.description: Conceal code, symbols, or strings to evade static analysis.

persistence.description: Register receivers, services, or boot-start handlers to survive reboots and maintain access.

webview_injection.description: Inject malicious content into WebView components to steal credentials or perform UI redressing.

native_library_abuse.description: Leverage native libraries to evade detection, perform sensitive operations, or access low-level APIs.
